title: Physical Features → Sign of the Lord of the Constellation of the Sub-Lord of Lagna = General Build; Constellation Modifies; Sub Decides Exact Height/Weight
summary: KP rule: Physical features are determined by the sign occupied by the lord of the nakshatra in which the sub-lord of the Lagna cusp is placed. The sign gives the general physical frame. The constellation (nakshatra) modifies it. The sub-lord of the Lagna decides precisely whether one is tall or short, plump or wiry. This three-level hierarchy works even for twins (where the sub changes but the constellation and sign may remain the same).
full_text: KP rule for physical features: (1) Find the sub-lord of the Lagna (ascendant) cusp. (2) Find the nakshatra (constellation) in which this sub-lord is placed. (3) Note the lord of that nakshatra. (4) Find the sign in which that nakshatra lord is placed. That sign indicates the general physical frame. The constellation modifies the sign's description. The sub-lord finally determines the precise physical characteristic (tall/short, plump/wiry). Planet aspects to the Lagna cusp also modify: Jupiter = overweight/generous build; Saturn = emaciated/lean; Mars = energetic/muscular; Mercury = plump with pale appearance; Moon = prominent features, long nose, piercing eyes; Uranus = long limbs; Rahu = tall; Ketu = short. This is applicable to all births including twins — the sub differs even within minutes.

result.effect: Sign of nakshatra lord of Lagna sub-lord = general build. Nakshatra = modifier. Sub = precise height/weight/build.

title: Height by Sign Group: Gemini/Leo/Sagittarius/Aquarius = Tall; Aries/Virgo/Libra/Scorpio = Average; Taurus/Cancer/Capricorn/Pisces = Short
summary: Signs are grouped into three categories for height: tall signs (Gemini, Leo, Sagittarius, Aquarius), average height signs (Aries, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio), and short signs (Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn, Pisces). Lord of Lagna in beginning of sign = tallness; middle = above average; between middle and end = shorter; fag end = short.
full_text: KP height classification by sign group: (1) Tall signs: Gemini, Leo, Sagittarius, Aquarius — natives with these signs prominent have good height. (2) Average height: Aries, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio. (3) Short: Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn, Pisces. Additionally, the degree position of the lord of Lagna within its sign modifies height: lord of Lagna in the beginning of a sign (0°-10°) = tallness; proceeding to middle (10°-20°) = above average height; between middle and end (20°-27°) = below average/shorter; in the fag end (27°-30°) = short. Robson notes that lord of ascendant and Moon without latitude at the end of a sign produce short persons. Ptolemy mentions that lord of ascendant with greater latitude causes stout persons.

title: Longevity Houses → 1 + 8 + 3 = Life; 12 + 7 + 2 = Maraka/Negation; 12th = Moksha (KP Framework)
summary: KP longevity framework: Houses 1, 8, and 3 are the longevity houses — benefics here contribute to long life. Their 12th houses (12, 7, and 2) are the negations — called Maraka Sthanas (2 and 7) and Moksha Sthana (12). One must first judge the type of ayush (short/middle/long) then identify which dasa will activate the Maraka planets.
full_text: KP rule: Houses 1 (vitality/self), 8 (longevity), and 3 (courage/life force) are the longevity houses. Benefics in these houses contribute for long span of life. The 12th house to any bhava is the negation of that bhava. Therefore: 12th from 1 = 12th house (negation of vitality = Moksha); 12th from 8 = 7th house (negation of longevity = Maraka); 12th from 3 = 2nd house (negation of life force = Maraka). Hence the 2nd and 7th are Marakasthanas and the 12th is the Mokshasthana. To judge longevity: (1) Determine the span type (Poorna Ayush = 66-100 years; Madhyama = 33-66; short = 0-33). (2) Identify the dasa/bhukti covering that age range when Maraka planets operate. (3) Cross-check with progression and transit aspects to ascendant and its lord.

result.effect: Houses 1+8+3 = longevity. Houses 2+7 = Maraka. House 12 = Moksha. Maraka dasa = timing of death.

title: Bhadhakasthana by Lagna Modality: Movable = 11th; Fixed = 9th; Common = 7th
summary: The Bhadhakasthana (obstructing house for longevity) is determined by the nature of the ascendant sign. For movable signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn): the 11th house is Bhadhakasthana. For fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius): the 9th house. For common/dual signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces): the 7th house. The lord of the Bhadhakasthana is the Bhadhakasthanadhipathi — the worst malefic for longevity.
full_text: KP rule on Bhadhakasthana: The Bhadhakasthana is the house that creates the greatest obstruction to longevity. Its determination depends on the modality of the ascendant sign: (1) Movable signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn): Bhadhakasthana = 11th house from that sign. E.g., Aries → Aquarius (11th); Cancer → Taurus; Libra → Leo; Capricorn → Scorpio. (2) Fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius): Bhadhakasthana = 9th house. (3) Common/dual signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces): Bhadhakasthana = 7th house. The Bhadhakasthanadhipathi (lord of the Bhadhakasthana) is the worst malefic for longevity. Planets in the constellation of Bhadhakasthana occupants are stronger evils than the occupants themselves (standard KP signification hierarchy).

title: Sub-Lord of Lagna Determines Longevity → Benefic Sub = Long Life; Malefic Sub = Short Life
summary: The sub-lord of the Lagna (ascendant) cusp is the single most important factor for longevity. If the sub-lord is a benefic (by lordship: lords of 1/5/9/10 are benefics; lords of 6/8/12 are malefics), the person lives long. If the sub-lord is a malefic, life is short. This is the KP rule that solves twin birth discrepancies in longevity — the sub changes within minutes.
full_text: KP rule: The sub-lord of the ascendant (Lagna) cusp governs health, vitality, immunity, and longevity. If this sub-lord is a benefic — the person lives long (benefic by lordship: lords of 1, 5, 9, 10 are benefics; lords of 6, 8, 12 are malefics; if a planet owns both a benefic and a malefic house, judge it as mostly benefic if the benefic house is stronger). If the sub-lord is a malefic, life is short. This distinguishes twin births where one lives and the other dies — the sub-lord of the Lagna cusp is the deciding factor because the cusp degree changes even within a few minutes of birth. Benefics in the Ascendant contribute to long span; lord of Ascendant forming favourable aspects with the ascendant and receiving harmonious aspects from benefics promises long life.

result.effect: Benefic sub-lord of Lagna = long life. Malefic sub-lord = short life. Twin proof: sub changes in minutes → different longevity for twins.

title: Marks / Moles → Masculine Lagna + Lord in Masculine = Right Side; Feminine = Left Side; Degree in Sign = Upper/Middle/Lower Body Location
summary: The side of the body (right or left) on which a mark or mole appears is determined by the masculinity/femininity of (a) the Lagna sign and (b) the sign occupied by the lord of Lagna. The degree position (first/middle/last 10°) of the Lagna or its lord within a sign determines whether the mark is on the upper, middle, or lower part of the body section indicated by that sign.
full_text: KP rule on marks and moles: (1) For male natives: Masculine Lagna + lord of Lagna in masculine sign → mole on the right side of the body part indicated by the Lagna sign. Masculine Lagna + lord of Lagna in feminine sign → Lagna sign's body part has mole on the right side, but the body part of the sign where lord is placed has mole on the left side. Feminine Lagna + lord in feminine sign → mole on the left side. Feminine Lagna + lord in masculine sign → right side. For female natives, the reverse. (2) Degree position determines the location on the body part: first 10° = upper one-third of that body part; middle 10° (10°-20°) = centre; last 10° (20°-30°) = lower part. (3) Scars and marks from disease/surgery/cuts are judged by finding which planet will cause disease/danger, which sign it occupies, what body part that sign governs, and when.

title: Kendradhipathya Does NOT Deny Longevity Alone → Waxing Moon/Mercury/Venus/Jupiter Owning Angular Houses (1/4/7/10) Are Not Automatically Malefic for Longevity
summary: KP explicitly states that Kendradhipathya (benefic planets owning angular/kendra houses) does not by itself deny longevity. This is a KP correction of the widely feared Kendradhipathya malefic rule. KP provides examples of Virgo-born natives living past 60 and 70 despite Jupiter owning the 4th and 7th (Kendra) houses and being in the Marakasthana.
full_text: KP correction rule: Kendradhipathya — the principle that waxing Moon, unafflicted Mercury, Venus, and Jupiter become malefic when they own angular houses (1, 4, 7, or 10) — is NOT a standalone reason to predict shortened life. Many astrologers are 'terribly afraid' of Kendradhipathya, but KP demonstrates with hundreds of Virgo-born natives (born 1909 and 1923 with Moon in Hastham star) that having Jupiter in the Marakasthana (2nd house) owning Kendra houses 4 and 7 still allowed these natives to complete the full 16-year Jupiter dasa in good health and then continue into Saturn dasa. Therefore, Kendradhipathya must be combined with many other factors before pronouncing shortened longevity. It is insufficient as an isolated indicator.

title: KP: Danger/Death Timing → Conjoined Period of Sign Lord + Star Lord + Sub Lord of 8th Cusp + Constellation Lord of That Sub Lord
summary: In KP, the timing of danger or death is found in the conjoined period of: (a) the lord of the sign where the 8th cusp falls + the lord of the star (constellation) + the lord of the sub of the 8th cusp + the lord of the constellation in which that sub-lord is deposited. OR (b) the same four-level chain applied to the 8th house lord's own position. The sub-lord is the decisive factor: a benefic sub-lord = escape/survival; a malefic sub-lord that is a significator of death = the person succumbs.
full_text: According to Krishnamurti Padhdhati, danger is indicated during the conjoined periods and sub-periods of: (a) the lord of the sign where the 8th cusp falls, the lord of the star of the 8th cusp, the lord of the sub of the 8th cusp, AND the lord of the constellation in which that sub-lord is deposited; OR (b) the lord of the sign where the 8th house lord was deposited, its star lord, its sub lord, and the lord of the constellation in which the 8th house lord's sub-lord is deposited. The sub-lord is the deciding factor: if the sub is ruled by a benefic promising long life or cure — even though there is danger — one will escape and survive. If the sub-lord is a malefic and a significator of death, one will succumb to it.

title: Nature of Death: Jupiter Sub = Pleasant/Peaceful; Mars Sub = Sudden; Saturn Sub = Chronic/Lingering
summary: The nature (quality) of death is determined by the sub lord of the 8th cusp: Jupiter sub = pleasant, peaceful end. Mars sub = sudden, unexpected end. Saturn sub = chronic, prolonged illness, lingering suffering.
full_text: The nature or quality of death is determined by the sub-lord of the 8th cusp. Jupiter ruling the sub of the 8th cusp shows a pleasant, peaceful end. Mars ruling the sub shows a sudden, unexpected death. Saturn ruling the sub indicates a chronic and lingering end — prolonged ailment or long suffering, possibly including accident by falling.

title: Place of Death: Sub-Lord of 8th Cusp Signification Determines Location
summary: The place where death occurs is determined by the houses the sub-lord of the 8th cusp signifies. 1/4/10 = in own place/home. 3rd = on a short journey (return journey). 6/8/12 = in jail, hospital, or unknown place. 9th = on a long journey or in a far-off place.
full_text: The place of death is determined by the houses signified by the sub-lord of the 8th cusp. If the sub-lord of the 8th cusp is the significator of houses 1, 4, and 10: the end occurs in the native's own place or home. If it is the significator of the 3rd house: death occurs while making a short journey, mostly on the return journey. If the sub-lord of the 8th cusp is the significator of houses 6, 8, or 12: death occurs in jail, in a hospital, or in an unknown/foreign place. If it is the significator of the 9th house: death will happen during a long journey or in a far-off place.

title: Health: Ascendant Cusp in Constellation of Lord of 6 or 8 = Low Immunity and Susceptibility to Infectious Disease
summary: If a person is born with the cusp of the ascendant falling in the constellation of the lord of the 6th or 8th house, they will have insufficient immunity and resistance against infectious diseases — easily susceptible especially during epidemics. The ascendant cusp is more vital than the ascendant lord for this assessment.
full_text: Krishnamurti Padhdhati states: if a person is born with the cusp of the Ascendant in the constellation of the lord of the 6th house (disease) or the 8th house (chronic/dangerous illness), they will not have sufficient immunity and resistance against infectious diseases. They are easily susceptible especially to infectious diseases and during epidemics. The ascendant cusp is more vital than the ascendant lord itself — twins born in the same lagna and constellation differ only in their sub; the twin born in the sub of a benefic lives long and is healthy, while the other suffers and dies early because their sub is governed by the lord of 8 or 6.

title: Disease Onset and Cure Timing: Disease in Period of 6th House Planet; Cure in Sub-Period of Lagna or 11th House Planet
summary: Disease begins in the period of a planet connected with the 6th house. Cure comes during the sub-period of a planet connected with the Ascendant or the 11th house (the 11th = 6th from 6th = the remedy house). If no planet is connected with the 11th, there is no cure.
full_text: Planets in any manner connected with the 6th house cause disease in their conjoined periods. Cure comes during the sub-period of a planet connected with the Ascendant or the 11th house — the 11th house is the 6th from the 6th, making it the house of remedy for disease. No person can recover from a chronic disease if there is no planet in the 11th, no planet in the constellation of the owner or occupant of the 11th house, and the 11th cusp and the lord of the 11th are in the sub of evil planets. Lepers and mentally deranged patients suffer until death precisely because the lords of all their dasas after contracting the disease are in the sub of the lord of the 6th and the 11th house is not strong.

title: KP Finance and Fortune: Houses 2, 6, 10, and 11 Govern Wealth — Planet Must Be in Sub of Significator of 2/6/11 to Give Financial Results
summary: In KP, financial improvement and wealth are governed by houses 2, 6, 10, and 11. Planets in the constellation of the occupants of these houses are the strongest for wealth. However, the planet must also be in the sub of the significators of houses 2, 6, or 11 for the financial result to manifest. If the sub-lord is evil, the person loses money in that planet's period. Planets in the constellation of the lord of 8 or 12 indicate financial loss, poverty, and debt repayment.

title: Recovery of Lost Wealth: Lord of 7 in Sub of Lord of 2 → Can Regain What Was Lost
summary: If the lord of the 7th house is placed in the sub of the lord of the 2nd house (the KP formulation), the native will regain those things which had been lost. This is the KP refinement of the traditional Vedic rule 'lord of 7 in second house → recovery of lost wealth.'

KP refinement: if the lord of the 7th is in the sub of the lord of the 2nd house, the same result applies. The sub-lord connection replaces the bhava placement requirement. Never can one regain what is lost if the lord of the 8th is in the 2nd or 3rd house — in that case, property dwindles and nothing that is lost can be recovered. Malefics in the 8th house destroy wealth. In Horary astrology, a malefic in houses 6/7/8 conjoined with the lord of the lagna shows loss of wealth that cannot be recovered.

title: 10th House is Maraka for Both Parents: 10th = 2nd from 9th (Father's Maraka); 10th = 7th from 4th (Mother's Maraka) — Promotion and Parental Death Coincide
summary: The 10th house is the Maraka (death-inflicting) house for both parents simultaneously: it is the 2nd from the 9th house (father's house) making it father's Maraka, and the 7th from the 4th house (mother's house) making it mother's Maraka. Therefore promotion/career achievement (10th house matter) and the death of a parent often coincide in the same planetary period.
full_text: The 10th house is generally termed Karmasthana — it governs profession, career achievement, inheritance, and religious functions. It is also the Maraka house for both parents. The 10th house is the 2nd house counted from the 9th (which represents the father) — the 2nd from any house is its Maraka. The 10th house is also the 7th house counted from the 4th (which represents the mother) — the 7th from any house is also its Maraka. Therefore, those who enjoy promotion during the period of the lord of the 10th often also lose one of the parents around the same time. The derived-house Maraka principle applies: planets in the constellation of the lord of the 10th can simultaneously give career success and precipitate parental death.

title: Retirement Timing → Houses 2+6+10 = Service; Their 12th Houses (1+5+9) = End of Service/Retirement; Conjoined Periods of Sig of 1+5+9 = Time of Retirement
summary: KP retirement rule: houses 2, 6, and 10 indicate service/employment. The 12th house to each of these (houses 1, 5, and 9) indicates cessation of that service activity. Retirement occurs during the conjoined periods of the significators of houses 1, 5, and 9. Transit confirmation: Sun transiting in the sign of the dasa lord, in the constellation of the bhukti lord, in the sub of the antara lord identifies the exact date.

(2) The 12th house from each of these service houses indicates end of that activity: 12th from 2 = 1st house; 12th from 6 = 5th house; 12th from 10 = 9th house. (3) Therefore, retirement is indicated by the significators of houses 1, 5, and 9. Their conjoined periods = the time of retirement. (4) Transit timing: Sun transiting in the sign governed by the dasa lord, in the star governed by the bhukti lord, and in the sub of the antara lord = the specific date of retirement. (5) Among all significators, Rahu and Ketu (the nodes) are stronger than the lord of the house in which they are placed and the planets with which they are conjoined — nodes must be prioritised. (6) The dasa/bhukti at time of retirement in the example case: Jupiter Dasa, Saturn Bhukti, Ketu Antara — confirming the combination of significators of houses 1, 5, and 9.

title: Lottery/Competition Win → Houses 1+2+3+6+10+11 Receiving Favourable Aspects = Gain; Houses 4+5+7+8+9+12 Receiving Good Aspects = Loss; 5th House = Tendency to Speculate; 6th = Loss to Competitors = Gain to Native
summary: KP rule for lottery/competition wins: houses 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, and 11 receiving favourable aspects promise victory over enemies and gain in lottery, games, and competitions. Houses 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, and 12 receiving good aspects = adverse/loss. The 5th house gives the mind to speculate. The 6th house is 12th from the 7th (opponent's loss) = native's gain. Sade-Sati is a meaningless slogan in KP.
full_text: KP rule for gains through speculation, lottery, competition: (1) Houses 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, and 11 receiving favourable aspects promise: victory over enemies, success in litigation, winning in competition, and gains in lottery and games. (2) Houses 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, and 12 receiving good aspects = these matters prove adverse and promise loss, not gain. (3) 5th house = mind to speculate; the tendency and opportunity to bet or gamble is shown by the 5th house — primarily by its lord's constellation and position. Moon in its own sign in the 11th bhava = gain without effort is assured during its sub-period. (4) The 6th house indicates the 12th to the 7th (opponents) = loss to competitors = gain to the native. Planets in the 6th (or their lords) during their period = bring about the opponent's loss and the native's gain through betting/competition. (5) Sade-Sati rejection: KP explicitly states that Sade-Sati (7.5-year Saturn transit) is a meaningless slogan used by astrologers with half-baked knowledge to explain native's difficulties. The actual result in any period is governed by the constellation, sub, and house signification of the dasa/bhukti planets — not by gross Saturn transit. (6) Transit confirmation for lottery win: day governed by Moon (Monday), Moon transiting in Rahu's star (Swathi), dasa lord Rahu transiting in Taurus in Mrigasira star (Mars lord) and Saturn sub = Mars owns the 2nd (income) and Saturn owns the 11th (gains) = gain confirmed.

title: Speculative Gain via Races/Betting → Sub of Dasa Lord = Source of Result; Rahu/Ketu Stronger than Sign Lord and Conjunct Planets; Planet's Dasa Gives Results Through Constellation Lord's Houses; 6th House Loss to Opponent = Gain to Native
summary: KP rules for gain through races/betting: (1) The sub-lord of the dasa planet's position = the source through which results come (not the house occupied or sign owned). (2) Rahu and Ketu are stronger than the sign lord in whose sign they are placed and the planets with which they are conjoined. (3) A planet's dasa gives results predominantly indicated by the houses owned by the lord of the constellation (nakshatra) the planet occupies. (4) The 6th house is 12th to the 7th (opponent's loss) = native's gain in betting/competition.
full_text: KP rules for speculative gains through betting/races: (1) Sub of dasa lord = source: a planet may own any house and occupy any house. Its actual results come through the lord of the sub it occupies (the sub-portion within the star). Moon in Pushya star (Saturn's star) in Rahu sub = Moon operates through both Saturn (lord of 5th = speculation) and Rahu (in 2nd house with planets). This is the critical KP refinement. (2) Rahu/Ketu superiority: Rahu and Ketu are stronger than (a) the lord of the sign in which they are placed and (b) the planets with which they are conjoined. Rahu in a sign gives the results of that sign's lord AND the planets conjoined with it. (3) Dasa results through constellation lord: the dasa lord's primary results are those indicated by the houses owned by the lord of the nakshatra the dasa planet occupies at birth — more strongly than any other factor. (4) Swabhukti (own bhukti): the commonly held view that Swabhukti (own dasa/bhukti) is bad is a classical sloka repeated without research. KP shows Swabhukti can be favourable if the dasa lord is well-placed. (5) Lord of 6 = loss to opponent = gain to native: Jupiter as lord of 6 operates during the bhukti to bring loss to the opponent in racing/betting, thereby giving the native unexpected fortune. (6) Transit timing for win: during the hora when Jupiter transits in the sign of the dasa lord = the dasanatha will confer the expected favourable result through speculation.

title: KP Debt Framework: 6th=Debt Incurred; 8th=Lender's Money / Other's Resources; 12th=Repayment/Expenses; Receiving Money=2+6+10+11; Discharge of Debt=4+5+8+12
summary: The KP framework for debt and borrowing: 6th house = debt incurred; 8th house = other people's money (from the lender's perspective — their 2nd from the 7th); 12th house = repayment or clearing of loans. Receiving money (income from any source) is indicated by planets connected with houses 2+6+10+11. Discharge of debts is indicated by planets connected with houses 4+5+8+12.
full_text: In KP, the debt framework is as follows: 6th house denotes debts — why and when one borrows. 8th house is the 2nd from the 7th (the lender's house) — it represents the lender's resources and finance. A benefic in the 8th of the borrower = regaining money with pleasure (as the lender's finances are strong). An evil planet in the 8th = difficulty for the person lending, threatening loss. 12th house indicates expenses, investment, repayment of loans, and lending money (12th = 6th from 7th = deterioration of lender's bank position). Therefore debt is simultaneously a receipt for the borrower and an expense for the lender. Receiving money is indicated by houses 2 (bank position), 6 (service income/raising loan), 10 (profession/inheritance), 11 (profit/gains). Discharge of debts is indicated by planets occupying or owning houses 4, 5, 8, or 12 (4 = 10th from 7th = lender's karma; 5 = 11th from 7th = lender's gains returned; 8 = 2nd from 7th = lender's finance; 12 = clearing off loans).

title: Direction for Borrowing: Rasi of Lord of 2 / Lord of 11 / Bhukti Lord Indicates Direction; Direct Motion = That Direction Only; Retrograde = All Directions Succeed
summary: The direction in which a person should go to raise a loan is indicated by the rasi of the lord of the 2nd house, or by the rasi of the lord of the 11th house, or by the lord whose bhukti is operating. If that lord is in direct motion at birth, the person should attempt borrowing only in the indicated direction. If retrograde, attempts in all directions will succeed.
full_text: Where to go to raise a loan is indicated by: (a) the rasi in which the lord of the 2nd house is posited, (b) or by the direction of the rasi occupied by the lord of the 11th house, and (c) by the lord whose Bhukti operates. If the above lords are in direct motion at birth: attempts made in the direction indicated by the rasi will be helpful — success only in that direction. If however the lord was retrograde at birth: the person can make attempts in all directions and there will be grand success in all quarters. Example: Leo ascendant, Mercury = lord of 2 and 11. If Mercury was direct, try in the north (Mercury's direction). If Mercury was retrograde, try anywhere — certain to succeed.

title: Borrowing → Conjoined Period of Significators of 2+6; Repayment/Clearing Debt → Conjoined Period of Significators of 8+12; Benefic in 8th = Lender Gets Money Back; Saturn as Sig = Installment Repayment
summary: KP debt framework: borrowing occurs during conjoined periods of significators of houses 2 and 6. Repayment and clearing of debt occur during conjoined periods of significators of houses 8 and 12. A benefic in the 8th house indicates the borrower will return the money; a malefic in the 8th = lender will struggle to recover. Saturn as the significator of repayment = installment payments (prolonged but not denied).
full_text: KP debt/loan framework: (1) Houses 2+6 = borrowing: the 2nd house is self-acquisition and bank position; the 6th house is borrowing. Conjoined period of significators of 2 and 6 = time of taking a loan. (2) Houses 8+12 = repayment: the 12th house indicates expenses, purchases, donations, and repayment of loans (discharge of debt). The 8th indicates windfall or loss. Conjoined period of significators of 8 and 12 = time of repayment or clearing the loan. (3) Lender perspective: if the borrower's chart has a benefic in the 8th house, the lender will recover the money during that planet's period — because the benefic in 8 is the 2nd from the 7th (lender's income). If the borrower has a malefic in the 8th, the lender will be depressed, disappointed, and unable to recover the loan. Lenders should check if a borrower has a benefic or malefic in the 8th before lending. (4) Saturn as repayment significator: if Saturn signifies the houses of repayment (8th or 12th), the repayment will come in installments — gradually, not in one lump sum. Saturn neither denies nor disappoints but always prolongs and delays the process. Lord of 12 in 8th = Vipareetha Raja Yoga — benefic lord of 12 in 8th enables the native to repay without strain. (5) Bank deposits = houses 2+10+11; 6th as 'other side of borrowing' also indicates deposits post-borrowing.

title: Property Recovery → 11th House Lord/Significator Retrograde = Temporary Loss = Recovery Possible; Direct Motion + 11th Unoccupied = Permanent Loss
summary: For stolen/lost property: If the significator of the 11th house (savings/profits/possessions) is RETROGRADE, the loss is only temporary — the property will be recovered. A retrograde planet gives a result that falls through when it turns direct. If the lord of 11th is in DIRECT motion and the 11th house is unoccupied, the native can never get the lost property back.
full_text: KP rule for recovery of stolen property (horary): The 11th house governs profits, savings, and fulfillment of desires including the return of lost property. To judge recovery: (1) If the lord of the 11th house is RETROGRADE: the loss is only temporary — the property will be returned. A retrograde planet gives a result which 'will fall through when it takes direct motion' — meaning what it took away, it returns. (2) If the lord of the 11th house is in DIRECT motion AND the 11th house is unoccupied (no planets in 11th): the native can never recover the lost property — the loss is permanent. The node (Rahu/Ketu) acting as the agent of the 11th lord should also be evaluated: if the node is ever-retrograde (Ketu), the thief cannot permanently retain the property, so recovery is indicated.

title: Possession Houses → 2nd = Movable Property (Cash/Jewels); 4th = Immovable Property (Land/Building); 11th = Savings/Profits/Gains
summary: In KP theft/loss judgment, the specific type of property lost is identified by house: 2nd house = movable property (cash, jewels, readily cashable possessions); 4th house = immovable property (land, buildings, vehicles); 11th house = profits, savings, gains. The lord of each house and its nodes indicate whether the specific type of property is threatened.
full_text: KP rule for property categorisation in theft/loss cases: (1) 2nd house: governs movable property — cash, jewels, bank balance, readily cashable possessions, other movable items. If the lord of 4th is in the 6th house (12th from 7th = the thief's loss), the immovable property was not taken — the thief gets no benefit from it. (3) 11th house: savings, profits, gains. The condition of the 11th lord (retrograde = loss temporary; direct = loss permanent) determines whether gains/savings are recovered. In a theft query, judge all three houses to determine which types of property are affected and which will be recovered.

title: Thief Description → 7th House Sign + Lord + Occupants in Horary Chart = Physical Description and Gender of Thief
summary: The 7th house of the prashna (horary) chart represents the thief (the opponent/other party). The sign, lord, and occupants of the 7th house give the physical description, gender, and nature of the thief. Masculine planet owning 7th = male thief. Feminine planets occupying 7th = female accomplices. Saturn aspecting 7th lord = dark complexion. Mars in 7th = bold/young thief.
full_text: KP horary rule for thief description: In the prashna chart erected at the moment of query, the 7th house and its occupants describe the thief. (1) Lord of 7th: determines the primary thief's gender and nature. Masculine planet (Mars, Sun, Jupiter, Saturn) = male; feminine (Moon, Venus) = female. (2) Occupants of 7th: additional thieves/accomplices. Feminine planets = female accomplices. (3) Mars as 7th lord = young man, bold culprit. Mars aspected by Saturn + Leo = dark in complexion. (4) Ketu in 7th: if Ketu represents the 2nd lord to the 7th (i.e., the 8th house of the thief), the thief cannot permanently retain the property. (5) Moon and Ketu in 7th = one male thief + two female accomplices (Moon = female, Ketu = converts the female number to two females when in constellation of a planet representing two). The 11th from the 7th (the thief's 11th = their gain) must also be assessed — if its significator threatens the thief's retention, recovery is confirmed.

title: KP Prashna Number System (1-108): Number ÷ 4 → Find Pada → Zodiac Degree → Prashna Lagna
summary: In KP horary, the querist is asked to give a number between 1 and 108. The zodiac is divided into 108 equal parts (27 nakshatras × 4 padas = 108 padas, each = 3°20'). The given number identifies the pada (counted from Aries 0°), which becomes the prashna Lagna. Division is: (number ÷ 4) → remainder 1/2/3/4 = pada of the resulting nakshatra (remainder 0 = 4th pada of the previous star).
full_text: KP prashna number system: The querist is asked to give any number from 1 to 108. The zodiac is 360° divided into 108 equal parts (each = 3°20'), corresponding to 27 nakshatras × 4 padas. The number given = the pada counted from Aries 0° (Aswini Nakshatra, 1st pada). Division method: divide the number by 4; if remainder = 1 = 1st pada; 2 = 2nd pada; 3 = 3rd pada; 4 (or 0) = 4th pada. The number of complete divisions × 1 nakshatra + the remainder pada identifies the exact nakshatra and pada. That degree range in the zodiac is taken as the prashna Lagna. Example: Number 16 → 16 ÷ 4 = 4 remainder 0 → 4th pada of the 4th nakshatra = Rohini 4th pada = 20°-23°20' Taurus. This becomes the ascendant for the prashna chart used to answer the query.

title: Plurality of Siblings → Sub-Lord of 3rd Cusp in Constellation of Planet in Dual Sign, or in Dual Sign Itself, or 3rd Cusp Receives Aspect from Planet in Dual Sign
summary: According to KP, there will be plurality of brothers, sisters, or both ONLY when: (a) the sub-lord of the 3rd cusp is in the constellation of a planet occupying a dual sign, OR (b) the sub-lord itself is in a dual sign, OR (c) the 3rd cusp receives a good aspect from a planet in a dual sign. Dual/common signs are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces.
full_text: KP rule for plurality of siblings: The sub-lord of the 3rd cusp is the key determinant. Plurality of brothers/sisters occurs when: (1) The sub-lord of the 3rd cusp is deposited in the constellation of a planet occupying a dual (common) sign. (2) The sub-lord itself is in a dual sign. (3) The 3rd cusp receives a beneficial aspect from a planet in a dual sign (e.g., Mars from Gemini by 8th aspect aspecting the 3rd cusp in Capricorn). Dual signs = Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces. In twin births, the 3rd cusp changes even within a few minutes — so the twin boy will have one more sister and one less brother compared to the twin girl. This proves traditional methods (using Moon sign or Lagna sign only) fail for sibling counting.

title: Siblings Exist → Significator of 3rd Connected with 2nd AND Significator of 11th
summary: KP rule: If the significator of the 3rd house is connected with the 2nd house (though 2nd is the 12th to the 3rd) AND is also a significator of the 11th house, the native will have siblings (co-borns).
full_text: KP rule: To confirm that a native will have siblings, the significator of the 3rd house must be connected with the 2nd house AND the significator of the 11th house must also be involved. The 2nd house is the 12th to the 3rd — it represents the negation of the next sibling. Yet when the 3rd significator connects with 2nd AND 11th, the 11th's fulfilment/acquisition overrides the 2nd's negation, resulting in the birth of siblings. This is the KP formula: sig of 3rd + sig of 2nd (12th from 3rd) + sig of 11th = co-borns will exist.

The 10th house is the 8th from the 3rd (i.e., 8th from the house of younger siblings), making it a malefic for the sibling. The timing of the danger: run the dasa/bhukti of the planet whose ruling planets match the ruling planets of the specific sibling at their birth.

title: Mother's Longevity → Judge from 4th Cusp as Mother's Lagna; Bhadhakasthana/Marakasthana from 4th = Her Death Indicators

full_text: KP derived-house rule for mother: The 4th house is taken as the mother's ascendant (Lagna). All of her life events are judged from this base: (1) Her possessions: 5th, 1st, and 2nd houses from native's Lagna (= 2nd, 10th, 11th from the 4th). (2) Her disease: 9th house from native's Lagna (= 6th from 4th). (3) Her death: Bhadhakasthana, Kendradhipathya, and Marakasthanas counted from the 4th house. (4) Critical rule: If the 4th cusp AND Moon are in the constellation of significators of the 9th, 11th, or 3rd house from Lagna (= 6th/8th/12th from the 4th), AND the sub belongs to the Bhadhakasthanadhipathi or Marakasthanadhipathi to the 4th house, the mother will be unhealthy, unhappy, and will not live long after the child's birth. For confirmation, obtain mother's chart and verify.

title: KP 4th House Discriminator: 4th + Mars Connection = Buildings; 4th + Venus = Vehicle; 4th + Moon = Mother; 4th + Mercury = Education
summary: In KP, the 4th house governs four distinct matters. The planet or house that also connects with the 4th house determines which matter is indicated: connection with Mars = buildings/land. full_text: According to KP, the 4th Bhava signifies mother, vehicle, education, and building. Mars is the planet governing buildings; Moon = mother; Venus = vehicle; Mars and Moon = land; Mercury = education. The planet connected with the 4th house determines which meaning applies. 'Connection with Mars' means: (a) the planet occupies a sign owned by Mars, or (b) occupies a star ruled by Mars, or (c) occupies the sub governed by Mars. When a 4th house planet has Mars connection = buildings/land. Venus connection = vehicle. Moon connection = mother. Mercury connection = education. Factors to judge for a dwelling house: (1) planets occupying 4th house AND in Mars star or Mars sub; (2) planets in constellation of those occupants; (3) lord of 4th in constellation or sub of Mars; (4) planets in constellation of such lords; (5) favourable situation of Mars to the 4th house.

title: House Acquisition Mode: 4+10 = Inheritance; 4+1+12 = Own Investment; 4+1+6+12 = Borrowing/Loan; 4+8 = Sale of Existing Property
summary: The mode of house acquisition is determined by which additional houses connect with the 4th house. 4th connected with lord of 10 = inheritance (no money withdrawn). 4th with 1+12 = own investment (native spends own savings). 4th with 1+6+12 = borrowing (co-operative loan or mortgage). 4th connected with lord of 8 = the property is being sold by the native.
full_text: How a house is acquired is determined by the connections of the 4th house: (a) 4th house receiving good aspects from the lord of 10 = the native gets a building by inheritance — no money is withdrawn from bank or borrowed. (b) 4th house connected with lords of 1 and 12 = the native invests own money and converts liquid cash to permanent possession (1st = native's effort; 12th = expenditure from own resources). (c) 4th connected with lords of 1, 6, and 12 = native borrows and invests; acquires through co-operative society or mortgages. (d) If lord of 1 is significator of 2 and 6 but has no Mars connection = borrows by mortgaging property. (e) If lord of 1 has no connection but lord of 4 and lord of 8 are connected = the native SELLS the property (the 8th being 2nd from 7th, the purchaser's 2nd house, represents the purchaser acquiring it). (f) Lord of 4 connected with lord of 12 and Sun = loses house by fire or public auction.

title: House Purchase: Houses 4+11+12 Determine Timing; Disposal/Sale: Houses 3+5+10
summary: To purchase a house, the significators of houses 4 (property), 11 (acquisition/gain), and 12 (payment — the cheque issued to the seller) must operate conjointly. To dispose of or sell a house, the significators of houses 3, 5, and 10 must operate.
full_text: To purchase a house: judge houses 4, 11, and 12 together. The 4th house indicates permanent possession (land and building). The 11th house indicates acquisition — immovable property being a specific form of gain. The 12th house indicates payment — the cheque issued in favour of the seller (loss of liquid cash = 12th = investment). Without payment (12th), possession cannot be obtained. To dispose of or sell a house: judge houses 3, 5, and 10. The 3rd house indicates agreement/communication/transfer of documents; 5th indicates the profit realisation or disposal action; 10th indicates the professional/public transaction that completes the sale. Note: taking possession of a purchased house also requires the 6th or 9th house to operate (6th = 12th from 7th = seller's loss; 9th = 12th from 10th/4th from 7th = seller departing the property).

title: Education: 4th = Regular Study; 3rd = Specialisation Desire; 9th = Higher Education; 3rd+5th = Native Intelligence; 4th = Studious Habit
summary: Each education-related house has a distinct role in KP. The 4th house governs regular school/college attendance and the habit of industry. The 3rd house shows inclination to specialise in a particular subject. The 9th house gives the taste and opportunity for further/higher study. The 3rd and 5th together show native intelligence, while the 4th specifically shows studious industry.
full_text: KP education signification framework: (1) Significator of the 4th house: indicates regular attendance at school or college and year-by-year study — represents studious habit and academic industry. (2) Significator of the 3rd house: shows inclination to specialise or deep desire to read a subject. (3) Significator of the 9th house: gives taste and opportunities for further/higher study (university, postgraduate). (4) 3rd and 5th together: show native (innate) intelligence. (5) 4th specifically: studious habit and diligent industry in study, distinct from mere intelligence (3rd+5th). These houses form the baseline framework for judging all education topics in KP.

summary: The sub-lord of the ascendant determines whether the native is studious or lazy. Mercury and Jupiter as (ascendant) sub-lords give the mind and facilities for study. Saturn as a significator of the 3rd house throws obstacles during study and causes the native to arrive late to exams and forget answers only after submitting.

Saturn, when it is a significator of the 3rd house, throws obstacles during the study period — specifically during examination time, Saturn causes the native to arrive late to the examination hall and to remember important points only after handing over the answer paper and leaving. This is Saturn's characteristic obstruction in the sphere of self-effort (3rd house).

title: Scholarship → 4th House Connected with 6th and 11th Houses
summary: Scholarship (non-repayable financial support for study) is indicated when the 4th house is connected with both the 6th and 11th houses. The 6th house is the institution's loss (it gives without expecting return); the 11th is the native's gain. Houses 8 and 12 with 4th = paying own fees; 4th + 6th + 11th = scholarship.
full_text: KP rule: To receive a scholarship for education, the 4th house (study) must be connected with the 6th house (the 12th from the 7th = the institution's loss) and the 11th house (the student's gain/profit). The logic: the 6th house represents money that the institution loses (it is the 12th to the 7th, which is the institution). Since scholarship is a non-refundable grant, it is both the institution's loss (6th) and the student's profit (11th). Therefore 4th+6th+11th = scholarship. Contrast: 4th+8th+12th connection = paid study (student pays fees — 12th = expenditure, 8th = the school's gain as 2nd from 7th).

title: Nipuna Yoga → Sun Conjunct Mercury or Sun in Constellation/Sub of Mercury
summary: Nipuna Yoga (skill/proficiency) arises when Sun is in conjunction with Mercury or when Sun is placed in the constellation or sub of Mercury. However, this yoga does not specifically cause degree qualifications, and absence of Nipuna Yoga does not prevent one from being a double-degree holder.
full_text: KP rule on Nipuna Yoga: Sun in conjunction with Mercury, or Sun placed in the constellation or sub of Mercury, causes Nipuna Yoga — a combination for special skill or proficiency. However, this yoga does not mean the native will necessarily hold academic degrees; equally, people without Nipuna Yoga can be double-degree holders. This is a KP correction of the classical over-attribution of Nipuna Yoga to academic qualification. Additionally, Mercury in rapt conjunction (combustion), eclipsed, or retrograde does NOT deprive the native of education — Chief Engineers, Auditor Generals, and greatest mathematicians may have Mercury in such states.

title: Farming Vocation → Mars+Venus+Moon+Jupiter Connected with Houses 2+6+10; Conjoined Period of These Four Planets = Takes Up Farming; Sub Lord Quality: Saturn Sub = Adequate; Jupiter Sub = Bumper Yield
summary: KP rule for farming as a vocation: Mars (land), Venus+Mars (production), Moon (irrigation), and Jupiter (produce/progeny) must be connected with houses 2, 6, and 10 (income+service+career) for the native to take up farming. The conjoined period of Venus, Mars, Moon, and Jupiter marks the commencement of farming activity. Sub-lord quality: Saturn sub = results adequate but native not fully satisfied with profit. Jupiter sub = providential help, bumper crop, larger profits.
full_text: KP rules for farming vocation: (1) Four key planets for farming: Mars = land (Bhoomikaraka); Venus and Mars together = the action to produce from land; Moon = irrigation and water supply; Jupiter = progeny, production, and agricultural yield/produce. (2) One takes up farming if these four planets (Mars, Venus, Moon, Jupiter) are connected in any manner with houses 2 (income), 6 (work/service), and 10 (career/profession). (3) The conjoined period of Venus, Mars, Moon, and Jupiter = the time when farming activity commences (purchase of land and commencement of cultivation). (4) Sub-lord quality for farming satisfaction: a planet in the sub of Saturn as significator of farming = the native will have advantage/results but will NOT be satisfied with the net profit — Saturn always delays satisfaction and causes incomplete fulfilment. A planet in the sub of Jupiter as significator = providential help ensures the yield is satisfactory AND the price is good, leading to larger profits. (5) Property purchase for farming: significators of 2nd (acquisition), 4th (land), and 11th (gains/possession) operating jointly = purchase of the plot for farming. (6) Saturn in Scorpio star (Anuradha) = indicates chemical fertilisers in farming context (Saturn in watery/fruitful sign indicates fertiliser/chemical use).

source.chapter_name: When Can I Clear Off Loan?

title: Agreement/Contract → Houses 3+9 (Both Parties Sign); Loan Repayment Timing → Conjoined Period of Planets in Constellation of Planet in 8th; Saturn as Repayment Sig = Installments Only
summary: KP rules: (1) An agreement/contract involves two parties, so judge both the 3rd house and the 9th house (3rd from the 7th). (2) Loan repayment timing = the conjoined period of planets deposited in the constellation of the planet situated in the 8th house. (3) Saturn as a significator of the repayment houses = payments are always made in installments; Saturn delays but does not deny. Saturn owning both 11th and 12th = on Saturn-governed days, the native both receives money (11th) and also issues cheques (12th).
full_text: KP rules for loan repayment and contracts: (1) Agreement/contract = houses 3 and 9: an agreement involves the native (1st) and another party (7th). The 3rd house = native's communication/signing; the 9th house = 3rd counted from the 7th = other party's signing. So judge houses 3 and 9 together for contracts and agreements. (2) Repayment timing: loan repayment (clearing the debt) = houses 8 and 12. The conjoined period of planets placed in the constellation of the planet in the 8th house = the time of making each repayment installment. When these conjoined periods operate, the native pays — whether the creditor agrees or not. (3) Saturn as repayment significator: when Saturn is a significator of repayment (signifying 8th or 12th houses), payments will always come in installments — partial, not full. Saturn is not denying — it is a delaying planet that fulfils desire slowly. It is true for disease (chronic), true for loans (installment), true for all things it significates. (4) Saturn owning two houses (e.g. 11th and 12th): on days governed by Saturn, the native both gets money (11th) and spends/issues cheques (12th) — both functions are governed by the same planet. (5) Ruling planets confirmation: the lord of lagna at the time of consultation, and the lord of the star in which Moon transits at consultation, should agree with the native's natal ruling planets — this confirms the horoscope accuracy.

result.effect: Agreement = houses 3+9. Repayment = planets in constellation of 8th-house planet. Saturn as sig = installments only, never lump sum.

title: Classical Blindness Rules (23 Rules) Are Too General → KP Rejects Them as Unreliable
summary: KP lists 23 classical Parashari rules for blindness but explicitly states that following these rules would make nearly everyone blind. He demonstrates with a case of a congenitally blind child that NONE of the 23 classical rules apply to that chart, yet the child is blind. KP demonstrates his own rule (Sun/Moon/Venus period + 12th sub connection) accurately predicts the blindness instead.
full_text: KP critical assessment: The 23 classical rules for blindness (from various Hindu texts) are so general that 'we should be blind and deaf according to these rules.' Example: traditional rules include — 'lord of Lagna conjoined with Sun and Venus in 6/8/12 = born blind'; 'Moon and Mars in 6/8/12 = blind from fall'; 'Sun and Moon conjoined in 1/3/4/7/10 = uses spectacles'; 'Saturn in 12, Moon in 2, Sun in 8 = loss of vision'; etc. KP tested these 23 rules on the horoscope of a child born blind (12-8-1968, Lagna 24°37') and found that NONE of the 23 rules applied to that chart. The child is congenitally blind, yet no classical rule fires. KP's own rule (Ketu in 12th, Saturn/Mercury/Venus in Ketu's constellation, + 12th cusp sub-lord signifying defect) correctly explained the blindness. Conclusion: the classical rules must be abandoned.

title: Marriage Promise: Houses 2, 7, and 11 Are the KP Marriage Houses — All Three Must Be Judged

title: Partnership Longevity (Horary): Judge Badhaka and Maraka Houses Counted FROM the 7th House
summary: To determine the longevity of a business partnership (or any 7th house relationship), judge the Badhakasthana and Maraka houses counted FROM the 7th house — not from the lagna. The 7th house is the relevant base for partner-related longevity questions. The Badhakasthana for the 7th depends on the sign of the 7th cusp (movable=11th from 7th=5th; fixed=9th from 7th=3rd; dual=7th from 7th=1st). The Marakas for 7th are 2nd and 7th from the 7th (i.e., 8th and 1st from lagna).

The Marakasthanas for the 7th are the 2nd and 7th counted from the 7th house (i.e., 8th and 1st from lagna). Significators of these Badhaka and Maraka positions operating in the DBAS indicate the end/dissolution of the partnership. Ruling planets at the time of judgement are used to select the strongest significators.

title: KP Profession Determination → 10th Cusp Sign Lord + Star Lord + Sub Lord (Triple) Combined = Nature of Profession
summary: According to KP, profession is determined by identifying exactly where the 10th cusp (meridian) falls, then reading the sign lord, star lord, and sub lord of that precise degree. The combination of these three planets — plus the planet very close to the meridian — indicates the nature of the profession. The dasa lord in progress further specifies the current avocation.
full_text: KP method for profession determination: (a) Identify exactly where the meridian (10th cusp) falls in degrees and minutes. (b) Note the lord of the sign in which the cusp falls. (c) Note the lord of the nakshatra (star) in which the cusp falls. (d) Note the sub lord (KP sub) of that precise degree. (e) Also take into account any planet very close to the meridian. The profession is indicated by the combination of these three lords (sign+star+sub) and the current dasa lord. Example: Meridian in Gemini 5° = Mercury (sign) + Mars (star Mrigashira or Ardra check) + Sun (sub) → Mercury+Mars+Sun combination = surgeon or government engineer. The sub lord specifically refines and determines the exact line among alternatives suggested by sign+star. This replaces the classical method of navamsa lords of 10th house lords.

title: Sub Period (Bhukti) Indicates Change in Nature of Profession — Not Fixed to One Avocation Throughout Life
summary: According to KP, the sub periods (bhukti) indicate changes in the character or type of profession over a lifetime. A person may be a teacher in one bhukti, a legal adviser in another, and a public prosecutor in yet another. The sub lord determines which aspect of the broader profession indicator operates at any given time.
full_text: KP principle on sub periods and profession changes: A person's profession is not fixed to one avocation throughout life. The sub periods (bhukti/anthra) govern changes. Example: During Jupiter bhukti = teacher. During Saturn/Mercury/Ketu sub periods = legal adviser in a labour company. During Venus sub period = Public Prosecutor. The broad profession is indicated by the 10th cusp sign+star+sub, but the specific current role is modified by the running bhukti lord's connections. One should be careful while predicting and should not assign a single lifetime profession based on the natal combination alone. The dasa and bhukti running must always be considered alongside the natal 10th cusp indicators.

title: KP Bhava Boundary Rule → House Runs from One Cusp to the Next; Lord = Lord of the Cusp Sign (Not Intermediate Sign)
summary: KP definitively states that a house (bhava) runs from its cusp to the next cusp. The lord of the house is the lord of the sign in which the cusp falls — even if the house extends into another sign. The traditional Bhava Chakra (Chaleeth) method that shows planets in the preceding sign is misleading.
full_text: KP house boundary rule: A bhava commences exactly at the cusp and ends at the next cusp. The lord of the bhava is determined by the sign in which the cusp falls — not by any intermediate sign the bhava may extend into. Example: If the 2nd cusp is at 26° 56' Cancer and extends to 25° 56' Leo, the lord of the 2nd house is Moon (lord of Cancer, the sign of the cusp) — not Sun (lord of Leo, the intermediate sign). Traditional Bhava Chakra (Chaleeth in North India) incorrectly places planets in the sign preceding their actual position relative to the cusp, which is misleading. The correct KP approach: always assign house lordship to the lord of the sign where the cusp falls.

title: Business vs Service → Business = Speculative/Unsteady Income (Houses 2+7+10); Service = Steady Income (Houses 2+6+10); 7th House = Customers and Partnership
summary: KP distinguishes business from service by house signification: business involves houses 2+7+10 (unsteady, speculative, customer-facing), while service involves houses 2+6+10 (steady, subordinate). The 7th house represents customers, partnerships, and those one deals with in business.
full_text: KP rule distinguishing business from service: (1) Service (employment) = significators of houses 2 (income), 6 (service/subordinate position), and 10 (career). Gives steady, predictable income with a master. (2) Business = significators of houses 2 (income), 7 (customers/partners/public dealing), and 10 (career/status). Income is unsteady or speculative because it depends on market conditions and customer relationships. (3) The 7th house is the key differentiator: in business, the 7th represents customers and business partners. In marriage context the same 7th represents the spouse. The context determines the interpretation. (4) House 6 vs house 7 = service vs business: if 6th significators dominate over 7th, the native is in service; if 7th significators dominate over 6th, the native does business.

title: Classical Navamsa Method for Profession Fails for Twins → KP 10th Cusp Sub Lord Method Succeeds
summary: The classical Parashari method (finding lord of navamsa sign occupied by the lord of the 10th house from Lagna/Moon/Sun) fails for twin births because all three positions are identical for twins but the twins have different professions. KP's 10th cusp sub-lord method succeeds because the sub-lord changes even within a few minutes of birth (the cusp degree changes).
full_text: KP critique of classical profession method: Traditional Hindu texts (Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Mantraeswara's Phaladeepika) all rely on finding the navamsa sign occupied by the lord of the 10th house from Lagna, Moon, or Sun. For twin births, the lagna, Moon, and Sun are nearly identical — so the lord of the 10th house is the same, its navamsa sign is the same, and the profession indication is the same. Yet twins demonstrably have different professions (e.g., one a medical practitioner, the other an advocate/vice chancellor). This proves the classical navamsa method fails. KP's method uses the 10th cusp sub-lord: since the cusp degree changes even in a few minutes (birth interval between twins), the sub-lord differs, giving different profession indications. This is the definitive proof of KP's superiority for profession determination.

title: Independent Business Houses → 2+7+10 (vs Service 2+6+10); 7th = Customers (Who You Sell To), Partners, Public; 6th = Those You Buy From / Borrow From
summary: KP rule: Independent business is governed by houses 2 (income), 7 (customers/partners), and 10 (career), in contrast to service which uses 2+6+10. Within the 7th house: house 6+7 = those you buy from; house 7+12 = those you sell to. The 7th cusp and its sub-lord determine whether independent business is supported.
full_text: KP rule for independent business vs service: (1) Service houses: 2+6+10. The 6th house = subordinate/working under another. (2) Independent business houses: 2+7+10. The 7th house = customers, partners, the public you transact with. (3) Detailed 7th house signification in business context: houses 6+7 = those from whom you buy or borrow (suppliers, creditors); houses 7+12 = those to whom you sell (customers, debtors). (4) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is the primary determinant: it must signify houses 2, 7, 10, and/or 11 for independent business to be viable. If the 7th cusp sub-lord connects with 6, the native will be in service rather than independent business. (5) KP's combinatorial precision: 249 subdivisions × 9 planets × 12 signs = 26,892 possible profession combinations — this is why KP outperforms traditional methods in identifying exact profession type.

title: Business Loss → Saturn as Sub of 7th Cusp Lord/Significator (KP Correction: Not Just Saturn in 7th as Westerners Claim); Earthy Sign + Sub-Lord of 7th in 5/8/12 in Earthy Sign = Business Loss
summary: KP corrects Western astrology: business failure is NOT simply from Saturn placed in the 7th house. The real indicator is Saturn being the sub-lord of the 7th cusp's lord/significator. Additionally: if the sign on the 7th cusp is earthy AND the sub-lord of the 7th is in house 5, 8, or 12 in an earthy sign = business loss is promised.
full_text: KP rule for business loss (two conditions): (1) KP correction of Western claim: Westerners say 'Saturn in the 7th house = bad for business.' KP refutes this: Saturn placed in the 7th is not the determinant. The correct rule is: Saturn as the sub-lord of the 7th cusp's significator (or as the sub-lord of the 7th cusp itself) = business difficulties and losses. Many with Saturn in 7th do successful business; it is the sub-level connection that matters. (2) Earthy sign business loss rule: If the 7th cusp falls in an earthy sign (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn) AND the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is placed in houses 5, 8, or 12 AND that sub-lord is also in an earthy sign = business loss is indicated. The earthy sign on 7th + adverse sub placement creates a concrete, material loss pattern for earthy/land-based business dealings. (3) General principle: always use the sub-lord of the relevant cusp, not gross planetary placement in the house, to determine outcome.

title: Music Aptitude → 5th House; Sub-Lord of 5th in Constellation of Planet in Leo/Aquarius = Popular Musician; Planet-Sign Combinations for Rhythm/Pitch/Harmony/Composition
summary: KP rule for music: the 5th house governs music ability. The sub-lord of the 5th cusp in the constellation of a planet in Leo or Aquarius = popular musician. Various planet-sign combinations determine specific musical aptitudes: Moon+Venus = taste for improvement; Venus+Mercury = composing ability; Mars = no stage fear; Saturn+Mercury = scholarly composition; Jupiter = prayers/devotional music; Mercury = dance compositions.
full_text: KP rules for music aptitude and talent: (1) 5th house = music. Whether one will learn, appreciate, become a musician, or hate music is judged from the 5th house — specifically through the sub-lord of the 5th cusp. (2) Sub-lord of 5th in constellation of planet in Leo or Aquarius = popular musician. Venus also strongly contributes to grand success in music. Mercury = Thalam (rhythm). (4) Sign of constellation lord of sub-lord of 5th determines musical style: Gemini or Sagittarius = renders music that appeals to audience's senses. Cancer or Capricorn = enjoys hearing music, Saturn dominant. Aries or Libra = changes rhythm at appropriate time; pitch changes. Virgo or Pisces = blending of notes, producing harmony. (5) Musical composition vs performance: Saturn as dominant significator of 5th house + Mercury connection = scholarly compositions. Jupiter + 5th = devotional compositions/prayers. Mercury = dance compositions. Saturn+Venus+Mars = love songs. Most composers are also skilled performers; but not all performers can compose. title: Photography as Profession → 10th Cusp in Venus Star = Photography (Venus = Photography by Nature); 11th Cusp Sub-Lord Determines Gains; Mercury Dasa = Period of Photography Profession
summary: KP rule for photography as profession: the 10th cusp falling in a Venus-ruled star indicates photography as a profession — Venus, by its inherent nature, denotes photography. (2) Profession quality and success = 11th cusp sub-lord: the sub-lord of the 11th cusp governs gains from the profession. In the example: Mercury as 11th cusp sub-lord in the 6th house in Saturn star Jupiter sub — Saturn is lord of 11 and 12 connecting the 11th house; the 6th house placement shows work/service context. (3) Timing: Mercury Dasa starts the period in which photography as a professional career becomes active. The dasa/bhukti operating at the time of career commencement will have Mercury (or relevant planet) as significator connected with the 10th house and Venus. (4) General principle: the NATURE of the planet governing the star in which the 10th cusp falls determines the type of profession. Venus star = visual/artistic/photography; Mars star = engineering/sports; Saturn star = mining/service industry; Mercury star = communication/commerce.

summary: KP rule for transfer prediction: judge houses 3 (short journey/change of surroundings), 9 (long journey/distant transfer), and 12 (leaving home/separation from family, change of quarters). title: Spouse's Transfer → Derived Houses from 7th: 3rd from 7th = 9th from Lagna; 9th from 7th = 3rd from Lagna; 12th from 7th = 6th from Lagna
summary: KP derived-house rule for spouse's transfer: take the 7th house as the spouse's lagna and count transfer houses (3+9+12) from there. The 3rd from the 7th = 9th from lagna; the 9th from the 7th = 3rd from lagna; the 12th from the 7th = 6th from lagna. Judge these derived positions to determine whether and when the spouse will be transferred.
full_text: KP derived-house application for spouse's transfer: To judge the transfer of the spouse (7th house person), one takes the 7th house as their lagna (ascendant) and applies the transfer houses (3, 9, 12) from that derived reference point. Derivation: (1) 3rd from 7th = 9th house from the native's lagna. (2) 9th from 7th = 3rd house from the native's lagna. (3) 12th from 7th = 6th house from the native's lagna. Therefore, to judge the spouse's transfer, examine the significators of houses 9, 3, and 6 from the native's lagna. Similarly for promotion at transfer: houses 2+6+10+11 from 7th = 8+12+4+5 from lagna. This derived-house method is universal — it can be applied to any relative by taking the house representing that relative as their derived lagna and counting the relevant event houses from there.

title: Termination of Service → Houses 1+5+9+12 (Negation of 2+6+10+11); 1=Negation of 2nd; 5=Negation of 6th; 9=Negation of 10th; 12=General Loss
summary: KP rule for termination of service: judge houses 1, 5, 9, and 12, which are the negations of the service houses 2+6+10+11. The 1st house negates the 2nd (self-acquisition — income ends). summary: KP explicitly rejects the traditional rule that planets in 6/8 mutual position (shasthashtama) cannot give positive results in their conjoined periods. Proven by case: Saturn Dasa Mercury Bhukti (Saturn and Mercury in 6/8 to each other) gave service entry AND marriage. Venus (in 6 to Saturn) gave confirmation in commission. KP teaches: what matters is which HOUSES the planet signifies, not its angular relationship to the dasa lord. The 6/8 mutual position between planets is irrelevant to result prediction in KP.

title: Regaining Lost Position → Houses 10+11; Ruling Planets at Consultation Must Agree with Natal Ruling Planets for Accurate Reading
summary: KP rule for regaining lost position: judge houses 10 (position, fame, honour in profession) and 11 (realisation of ambition). Both houses must have their significators operating in dasa/bhukti at the time of reinstatement. Transit confirmation: the ruling planets at the time of consultation — lord of the day, star in which Moon transits, sign in which Moon transits — should agree with the planets governing the event in the native's chart.
full_text: KP rules for regaining lost seniority/position: (1) Houses 10 and 11 govern regaining of position: the 10th house indicates position, fame, reputation, and honour in profession; the 11th house shows realisation of ambition. Both must have their significators operating concurrently for reinstatement. (2) When a native's seniority is restored, the lords of 10th and 11th cusps (and their significators) must be active in the dasa/bhukti at that time. (3) Ruling planets confirmation: the ruling planets at the moment of consultation should agree with the planets that govern the outcome in the natal chart. Ruling planets = (a) lord of the day; (b) lord of the star in which Moon transits at consultation; (c) lord of the sign in which Moon transits. In the example: Moon transiting in Bharani (Mars star, Venus sign) at consultation = the same planets (Mars and Venus) that govern the 10th and 11th houses in the native's chart — confirming the horoscope's accuracy and the timing of reinstatement. (4) KP explicitly states: such coincidences are not accidental — one can consult an astrologer only at such a time when the ruling planet at that moment agrees with the ruling planets at his birth moment.

summary: KP rule for pension and financial account settlement: judge houses 2 (finance/income) and 11 (gains/receipts). For service pensions specifically, also include house 10. title: Political Success → Cusps of Houses 1+6+9+10 Receive Benefic Aspects; Sub-Lords of Those Cusps in Constellation of Benefics Connected with 1+6+9+10+11
summary: KP rule for political fortune: the cusps of houses 1, 6, 9, and 10 must receive beneficial aspects. The occupants of those houses must be in the constellation of benefics by lordship, and the sub must be ruled by benefics connected with houses 1, 6, 9, 10, and 11. House 1 = native's enjoyment; house 6 = defeat of enemy; house 9 = providential/destiny support; house 10 = fame/reputation/profession; house 11 = fulfilment and success in election.

(3) House significations: 1st = the native enjoys the benefit personally; 6th = victory over opponents (failure and loss to opponent = native wins); 9th = providential help, meritorious destiny (Bhagya); 10th = name, fame, reputation, popularity, profession; 11th = success in election, realisation of ambition, fulfilment of desire. (4) Supporting planets: Mercury = oration and public communication; Mars = authority, bold administration; Saturn = trust and responsibility; Jupiter = wisdom and expansion; Venus = worldly popularity and pleasure. title: Minister Selection Denied → Sub-Lord of 10th Cusp RETROGRADE = Negative Result Despite Apparently Favourable Development; Retrograde Sub Overrides All Favourable Placements
summary: KP rule: if the sub-lord of the 10th cusp (the career/status cusp) is retrograde, the result will be negative despite seemingly favourable planetary placements and developments. The retrograde motion of the sub-lord blocks the fulfilment of the 10th house promise. Applies specifically to career and ministerial status.
full_text: KP rule for career/minister selection: The sub-lord of the 10th cusp must be direct (not retrograde) for positive career results. If the sub-lord of the 10th cusp is retrograde, the result will be negative despite apparently favourable planetary configurations and promising developments. From the case (horary number 37, 29-8-1969): 10th cusp meridian in Rahu's star Saturn's sub. Rahu is in Saturn's sign (represents Saturn). Saturn is retrograde. 'Since the sub lord of the 10th cusp, Saturn, is retrograde, the result will be negative in spite of apparently favourable development. The querist need not entertain any hope of becoming a minister, even though he will enjoy popularity and prosperity.' The retrograde sub-lord principle generalises: whenever the sub-lord of the relevant cusp is retrograde, the result of that cusp/matter is denied or reversed.

title: Helpful Friends → Lord of 11th in Constellation of Lord of 1/2/3/6/10/11; Harmful Friends → Lord of 11th in Constellation of Lord of 4/5/7/8/9/12
summary: KP rule for friendship quality: if the lord of the 11th house (friends/gains) is in the constellation (or sub) of the lord of houses 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, or 11, the friend will be genuinely helpful and the native gains. If the lord of the 11th is in the constellation of the lord of houses 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, or 12, the friend will cause loss, betrayal, or grief.
full_text: KP rule for choosing friends: The 11th house governs friends, elder brothers, gains, and permanent associations. The lord of the 11th, and planets signifying the 11th house, determine the quality of friendships. (1) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 1 = sincere, permanent friend who materially helps. (2) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 2 = friend through whom one makes money and gains. (3) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 3 = friendship made during short journeys or by correspondence; may be temporary; if lord of 3 is also lord of 12 = that person is a cheat and secret enemy. (4) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 4 or 9 = friend who takes money and material and is never grateful. (5) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 5 = native always loses to the friend; especially true if lord of 5 is also lord of 8 or 12. (6) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 6 = native gains; the friend gives and native receives — good for games/card playing. (7) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 7, 8, or 9 = unreliable friend, time-serving. (8) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 10 = most helpful and faithful friend; brings reputation, honour, prestige. (9) Lord of 11 in its own constellation = permanent, very useful friends. (10) Lord of 11 in constellation/sub of lord of 12 = dangerous; such friends are secret enemies; never rely on them. General rule: benefics in the constellation of lord of 12 = pleasant expenses/investment (not treachery); malefics in the constellation of lord of 12 = ultimate loss regardless of house owned or occupied.

result.effect: Lord of 11 in constellation of lord of 1/2/3/6/10/11 = helpful friend. In constellation of lord of 4/5/7/8/9/12 = loss or betrayal through friend.

summary: KP power comparison rule for friend vs enemy: if the lord of 12 is stronger than the lord of 1 or 11, the secret enemy has more power. If lord of 7 is stronger than the Lagna lord, the opponent in litigation or competition wins. full_text: KP rule for friend/opponent power comparison: (1) If lord of 12 (secret enemies, loss) is stronger than lord of 1 (self) or lord of 11 (friends/allies), the secret enemy is more powerful and can harm the native. (2) If lord of 7 (open opponent/partner) is stronger than lord of Lagna (self), the opponent in litigation, contest, or competition is more powerful and will prevail. (3) If lords of 1, 2, 6, and 11 are collectively stronger than lords of 7, 8, 12, and 5 — the native will always gain, win the litigation, come out victorious in election, pass competitive examinations, and win in all competitions. (4) Those born in the same rising sign should avoid making friends with people whose ruling planets are the lords of 3 and 12 (for Cancer-born this means Mercury and Jupiter; for Capricorn-born also Mercury and Jupiter) — they will betray at the critical moment.

title: Receiving Gifts/Benefits → Houses 2+3+6+11; Giving Gifts → Houses 8+9+12+5 (= 2+3+6+11 Counted from 7th House)
summary: KP rule by Krishnamurti: receipts (receiving gifts, money, assistance) are governed by houses 2, 3, 6, and 11. Giving (donating, gifting to others) is governed by houses 8, 9, 12, and 5. The logic: houses 2+3+6+11 counted from the 7th house (the other person) = 8+9+12+5 from the native's lagna = what the native gives away.
full_text: KP rule 'According to me (Krishnamurti)': (1) RECEIPTS: judged from houses 2 (income, bank increase), 3 (Sahaya = assistance/help received), 6 (parting away by the giver — one person's 6th = another receives), and 11 (gains, what is due). (2) GIVING: judged from houses 8 (negation of 2nd = decrease of bank), 9 (negation of 3rd = giving assistance), 12 (negation of 11th = loss of gains), and 5 (negation of 6th). (3) Universal derivation: houses 2+3+6+11 counted FROM the 7th house (the recipient) = 8+9+12+5 from the native's lagna = what the native gives. This proves the rule is universally consistent. (4) Significator strength order for receiving/giving: strongest = planets in constellation of occupants of 2+3+6+11; then occupants of those houses; then planets in constellation of lords of those houses; then lords of those houses; then planets conjoined/aspected by them. (5) Traditional rules excluded: Prithuyasas (Moon in 7th = liberal giver), Mercury in 10th, Mahadeva's 7 conditions, Vaidyanatha's 4 conditions, Westerners (8th house for gifts) — all override-rejected in favour of KP's house-signification approach.

title: Imprisonment → Houses 2+12; Release → Houses 2+11; Rahu = Chief Significator for Jails; Evil Periods of 2+12 = Confinement; Benefic Periods of 2+11 = Release
summary: KP imprisonment framework: confinement is indicated by malefics connected with houses 2 and 12. Release is indicated by benefics connected with houses 2 and 11. Rahu is the chief significator for jails. The period governed by evil planets connected with 2 and 12 = time of imprisonment; the period of benefics connected with 2 and 11 = time of release. The interval between these two periods = duration of imprisonment.
full_text: KP rule for imprisonment: (1) House 2 = life with family (separation from family = imprisoned). House 12 = restriction of movement, change of residence and bedding, separation from homeland. (2) Imprisonment occurs when malefics are in the constellation of planets in houses 2 and 12, when occupants of 2 and 12 own evil houses, and when evil planets are in the constellation of lords of these houses. (3) If lord of 1 is also connected with these significators = the native courts imprisonment himself. (4) Lord of 6 connected with these = imprisonment due to inability to repay loan, civil suit. (5) Jupiter, Venus, or lord of 9 and 1 connected with significators = political imprisonment. (6) Mars lord of 8 connected = punished for theft. (7) Saturn and Mercury = forgery, falsification of accounts, misappropriation. (8) Mars, Saturn, Venus = rape, kidnapping, brothel. (9) Mars and Saturn = murder. (10) Release = benefics in the constellation of significators of houses 2 and 11; reunion with family (2nd), free movement and independence (11th). (11) Duration of imprisonment = interval between when evil 2+12 periods operate and when benefic 2+11 periods operate. (12) Rahu (ascending node) = chief significator for jails. Good aspects to 12th cusp or its significators with evil aspects to 2nd cusp or its significators = confinement. (13) If evil planet connected with 2 and 12 is in a fixed sign in houses 3, 6, 9, or 12 = long duration imprisonment. (14) If evil planet is lord of 1 (e.g. Saturn for Aquarius Lagna) also owning 6th or 12th and is combust or retrograde in 4, 7, 8, or 12 = habitual offender/jail bird.

title: Spiritual Concentration/Meditation → Moon in Sub of Saturn = Concentration Ability (KP); Benefic in 4th in Constellation+Sub of Benefic = Sincerity in Spiritual Practice
summary: KP rule for spiritual aptitude: Moon in the sub of Saturn gives the ability to concentrate and meditate. The mind, which is normally wavering, is steadied by Saturn's sub influence on Moon. Separately, a benefic placed in the 4th house, in the constellation of another benefic and in the sub of a benefic = the native is sincere, reliable, and incapable of entertaining evil thoughts.
full_text: KP rules for spiritual life assessment: (1) Concentration and meditation ability: Westerners claim Saturn forming a sextile aspect to the Ascendant promises concentration. KP refutes this positional claim. According to KP, the sub-lord of Moon's position determines concentration ability. If Moon is in the sub of Saturn, the native can concentrate and meditate. The mind, which is normally wavering and restless, is brought under control when Moon's sub belongs to Saturn. Any native with Moon in the sub of Saturn has the capacity for deep meditation and focused spiritual practice. (2) Sincerity in spiritual practice: A benefic planet placed in the 4th house, in the constellation of another benefic and in the sub of a benefic = the native is true, reliable, sincere, and cannot entertain evil thoughts. This combination creates an inner spiritual orientation that supports genuine practice. (3) The chapter emphasises that true spiritual attainment requires cultivating serenity, sincerity, and simplicity — these are either inborn or earned through practice. Saffron dress alone does not make a spiritual person; regular meditation and prayers are the test. (4) One can lead a family life and progress spiritually simultaneously — the highest spiritual path includes fulfilling worldly duties with detached attachment.

summary: KP rules for spiritual character: (1) Arrogance requires Mars connected with the Ascendant or lord of the Ascendant. If no such connection, the native is not arrogant. Mars in Saturn sub = unassuming and simple. (2) 5th house = spiritual initiation (Guru diksha); timing in conjoined periods of 5th house significators. (3) 10th house = yoga/karma/yagna/spiritual practice (one's spiritual work); must have a functioning 10th house connection for regular practice. (4) 11th house = spiritual progress; significators of 11 operating = improvement/progress.
